Hard rules for any agent touching this track: never re-tune exits on the existing negative-EV families, never cherry-pick assets, never relax a holdout gate after seeing results, never infer live edge from a 0-trade sample, minimum 60 days / 50 trades of paper trading after any pass before live is even discussed - trading stays halted (LIVE_TRADING off) regardless of any pass here. a ROADMAP.md study reaches a PASS verdict that requires the D3 human gate before any live promotion (D3 = live-promotion decision, never auto-satisfied by this loop).

LIVE_TRADING is found true anywhere, or a diff weakens an existing safety gate (stop bands, position cap, drawdown halt, order validation, min stop) rather than just reporting a research finding. This is the one case where the Verifier notifies directly instead of waiting for the next Architect cycle - see cajh-verifier-check's STEP 0 urgent check.

notification_policy.dedup: Before calling PushNotification for a given reasonKey, read notifications[reasonKey]. If it exists and now - notifications[reasonKey].lastSentAt < 6 hours, skip (already notified, don't resend). Otherwise call PushNotification, then read-modify-write the state file (re-read immediately before writing, strip BOM, merge only this key, write to .tmp and rename) to set notifications[reasonKey] = { lastSentAt: <ISO-8601 now>, message: <text actually sent> }.
notification_policy.message_format: Under 200 chars. Leads with the concrete issue or risk, not a status label. No jargon a non-engineer human would have to decode at a glance.
notification_policy.known_gap: PushNotification was newly added to these prompts and has never fired from a scheduled run before, so it is not yet in that task's stored tool-approval set. The first genuine trigger could pause on an unanswered approval prompt instead of notifying - the opposite of hands-off. Until the human has approved it once (e.g. via 'Run now' on cajh-architect-check/cajh-verifier-check, ideally with a real or deliberately-staged trigger condition present), treat notification delivery as unverified.
